# DataGridColumn

`Flare.Components.DataGridColumn`

A column as data: everything FlareDataGrid needs to render, sort, filter and edit one column, with no component attached. Declarative <FlareColumn> markup is projected into this shape, and a list of these can be handed to the grid directly through FlareDataGrid.ColumnDefinitions - which is how columns are generated from metadata, kept in a field, shared between grids or reordered in C# rather than in markup.
